text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ ate so much today!
Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "That went really well today too! Reminded me of our recital."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, everyone else's vegetables and cooking
are steadily improving in quality, too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm. So to stay at the top as a Yokozuna, you can never slack off on training!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Rice is gonna become a Yokozuna!
...Ah, no, I don't mean getting fat from overeating, okay!?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No, but truly magnificent!
It is plain to see you have not neglected your training!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, pardon me!
I just wanted to express my gratitude once again for the recital the other day.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "Thanks to you all, the students' awareness of nutrition has improved even further! You have my sincere gratitude!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...It might be time to start thinking about it.
The next stage, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Anyway! Thanks for the meal today!
Keep up the hard work!"
